name: River Development Agent Production Execution Authority Input Boundary Foundation
objective: Establish a narrowly scoped, explicit, fail-closed production authority-input boundary capable of carrying the human authorization, repository authorization, approved execution scope, and governance approval evidence required by the existing controlled execution-authorization chain, without treating execution intent as authorization or broadening existing authority.
requirements: Define the production authority-input boundary before connecting DEV-319 to real production callers.
Preserve the DEV-317 -> DEV-318 -> DEV-319 authorization dependency direction.
Carry explicit human authorization evidence rather than synthesizing it.
Carry explicit repository authorization evidence rather than synthesizing it.
Carry approved execution scope without broadening it.
Carry explicit governance approval evidence rather than synthesizing it.
Preserve requestedMode as execution intent only.
Fail closed when required authority evidence is absent or invalid.
Do not manufacture DEV-317 acquisition input from RiverDevOperationalExecutorIntegrationEntryAuthorization.
Preserve DEV-314 as the final operational executor integration entry boundary.
Do not grant commit, push, deployment, shell, network, secret-access, arbitrary repository mutation, or scope-expansion authority.
Perform source discovery before selecting production implementation files.
qualityGates: Existing authorization evidence contracts are identified from production source.
Existing approval evidence contracts are identified from production source.
Existing approved-scope source is identified from production source.
Existing repository-root source is identified from production source.
The narrowest viable production authority-input contract is identified.
No production source is modified during initial DEV-321 discovery.
Repository working scope remains DEV-321 specification-only.
